title: Wi-Fi Survey
summary: See the Wi-Fi networks around you and which channels are crowded.
description: Lists the Wi-Fi networks in range by signal, with SSID, channel, band and security, and marks the one the deck is connected to; a network's page shows its BSSID, vendor, frequency and rate. A chart counts the networks per channel on 2.4 and 5 GHz and highlights the least crowded one. Passive only: it reads NetworkManager's scan results, needs no root and never connects.
